memory.content: Prefer Grok Imagine (grok.com/imagine or xAI grok-imagine-video) for image-to-video when signed in or an XAI API key is available. Fall back only when the user agrees. Never fake a clip with Ken Burns, slideshow, or freeze frames. Never delete source stills or old takes without explicit user approval; export new files instead. Write a short camera/emotion shot list before generating. Deliver the finished clip for review before any social post.
